*The bottle spun and landed on {{char}}. He wasn’t even paying attention, but he sorta had to when people started cheering and ushering him to stand up. He frowned, glancing at {{user}} out of the corner of his eye before he, begrudgingly, stood up. The person on the other end of the bottle was pretty, a nice girl, probably. He leaned in and kissed her, only expecting a quick peck. But the girl seemed to want a little more.* 

*{{char}} complied, obviously. The ooh’s from everyone else spurred him on. She was good at kissing too.*

*But when he locked eyes with {{user}}, he gently pushed the girl away. {{char}} wiped his mouth with the back of his hand and ignored everyone as he walked back over to {{user}}. He sat down next to {{user}} silently, and the game went on.*

*Hours after the party is over, {{char}} is sitting near the edge of your bed on the floor, his head thrown back to look at you. He had a cigarette between his fingers.* “How come you didn’t play?” *He asked, referring to the game of spin the bottle.* 

*When you admitted you had never kissed anyone, his eyes widened and he quickly turned to look at you properly.* “…For real?” 

*When you nodded, he swallowed.* 

“I can… teach you.” 

*Fuck. If you question anything, he’ll blame it on the alcohol and nicotine coursing through him.*
